name: Robert Palmer (1805-86) TN-TYGS-0021
description: One of 240 memorials recorded in Old Terryglass graveyard (TN006-003008-), Co. Tipperary. Headstone marking the graves of Robert Palmer (1805-86) Justice of the Peace & mill owner who died at Santa Cruse House, Carrigahorig, Co. Tipperary, in 1886, his wife Mary Palmer nee Fitzgerald (1811-91) who died in 1891 aged 80, and their nephew Edmond Doolan (1849-1928) who died in 1928.   Base of the headstone has been signed by the monumental sculptors, Killaloe, Marble, Works, County Clare. Quotation from the Book of Revelation, where the risen Jesus encourages the persecuted church in Smyrna. The "crown of life" symbolizes the ultimate, eternal reward of victory over suffering and spiritual death for those who remain steadfast. The verse provides comfort during times of trial. Psalm 23:6, expresses absolute trust in God's protection and a desire for unbroken, eternal fellowship with Him, both in this life and the next.  Visit: https://historicgraves.com/terryglass-old-cemetery/tn-tygs-0021/grave

name: Другий корпус СумДУ / "Окружний суд", м. Суми
description:
Історична будівля Окружного суду (1914-1917)
Пам'ятка місцевого значення №2787-См
Історична будівля Окружного суду (вул. Петропавлівська, 57) розташована на перетині вулиці Петропавлівської та Академічного провулку.
Проєкт споруди належить академіку архітектури В. Пруссакову, а будівельні роботи очолював міський архітектор Г. Шольц. Будівництво велося у 1914–1917 роках. Архітектура виконана у монументальних формах неокласицизму. Споруда різноповерхова (триповерхова з підвалом у центрі та двоповерхова по боках) та має два внутрішні світлові двори.
З 1996 по 2016 рік тут розміщувалася Українська академія банківської справи (УАБС), яка пізніше увійшла до складу Сумського державного університету як навчально-науковий інститут.
13 квітня 2025 року російські війська завдали ракетного удару двома балістичними ракетами по центру міста. Будівля Окружного суду була пошкоджена: удар прийшовся у праве крило з боку головного фасаду, повністю зруйнувавши два поверхи та пошкодивши несучі конструкції.

name: Best Friends Forever - Trump and Epstein statue
description:
🗽On September 24 2025, a provocative statue titled *Best Friends Forever* appeared on the National Mall in Washington, D.C., depicting President Donald Trump and the late Jeffrey Epstein holding hands and dancing. Installed by the anonymous art collective “The Secret Handshake,” the bronze-painted figures stood on white pedestals near the Capitol, accompanied by a plaque celebrating their “long-standing bond” in honor of Friendship Month.
The statue sparked immediate controversy, blending satire with political critique. Though it had a temporary permit from the National Park Service, it was removed within 24 hours for violating permit terms. The installation reignited public discourse around Trump’s past ties to Epstein, drawing attention from media, officials, and passersby alike. Despite its brief presence, *Best Friends Forever* left a lasting impression on the intersection of art, politics, and public memory.

Designed as a static decorative asset, this book is intended for use in fantasy, horror, adventure, mystery, and story-driven environments. This model was created from scratch as part of my Blender learning journey, focusing on modeling, texturing, UV mapping, and asset creation. The goal was to create a visually appealing book that can be placed naturally into a variety of scenes and projects.

This is a static 3D model and is intended as a decorative environment asset.

name: Forte do Rato / Forte de Santo António de Tavira
description:
Fort Santo António of Tavira, also known as Rato Fort or Lebres Island Fort, is located near the mouth of the Gilão River in Tavira, Faro District, Portugal. Designated a Property of Public Interest in 1983, it was originally built in the late 16th century during King Sebastian’s reign to defend against Muslim pirate attacks. However, the river mouth shifted during construction, reducing its strategic value. Still incomplete during Sebastian's 1573 visit, it was renamed for Saint Anthony in 1654. After Portugal's 1640 independence, it was renovated to support the nearby Fort São João da Barra. By 1792, it had a small garrison and limited artillery; by 1821, it was nearly abandoned. The fort was decommissioned in 1840. Restoration efforts began in the 1980s, focusing on structural repairs and preservation.

Location: Tavira, Portugal

name: John Seymour (1716-1811) Gravestone
description: Not one of the recorded 162 memorial stones in Castletownarra graveyard (TN019-002002-), County Tipperary.19th-century gravestone marking the grave of John Seymour (born c. 1716) who died on the 25th of March in 1811 aged 95. Erected by his son Darby Seymour. The inscription is framed within a border of semi-circular-shaped discs. Above the inscription there is a band of lozenges above which there is the Latin Gloria In Excelsis Deo, with band of lozenges above this. A naive Crucifixion scene consisting of Christ on the Cross with INRI either side. Beneath his arms on his left side there is a rooster standing on a pot with the Hand of God on his right side. Two encircled lozenge-shaped sunbursts visible either side of the base of the cross, flanked on either side by a ciborium. The crucifixion is framed within a decorative border of semi-circular shaped discs. Naked Jesus is depicted with long flowing hair with circular-shaped breasts & long wavy arms nailed to the cross, feet together at base of cross.

description: Головной убор в виде шлема, созданный талантливым фиксиком по имени Ада, из ОЦФ — Операционного Центра Фиксиков. Шляпомат был создан чтобы фиксикам было легче работать и скрываться от детей, которые разрушают электроприборы, чтобы поймать фиксиков и отнести их на передачу «Загадочные тайны» в обмен на 100000 долларов. К Шляпомату прилагается пульт, похожий на наручные часы. с помощью которого использующего шлем можно телепортировать к местонахождению пульта. Устройство должно было быстро перемещать по электрическим проводам, при этом полностью защищая носителя от воздействия электричества, однако имеет недоработки, из-за чего пагубно воздействует на психику и вызывает зависимость у тех кто использует его слишком часто.

name: Mourning Maria Tombstone - Creality Sermoon P1
description:
## Scanning
The scan was created in normal IR-mode with automatic exposure and geometry tracking. I started from the front and slowly moved around the part while keeping an eye on having enough overlap for tracking (rotating the scanner to reach in to the crevices works quite well to circumvent obstructions due to limited line of sight). While scanning the framerate was roughly 10 FPS with some highs to 15 and lows to 6 FPS (NIR mode still needs an update I guess, currently no marker scanning supported). 

## Post-Processing
For post processing I first transferred the scan data from the P1 to my workstation. You can either do it by cable where a nice import menu opens or over WiFi where you select the project on the scanner, join the hotspot of the scanner with your PC and send it to the PC (option I chose, simply less cables and quite fast with up to 120MB/s from testing). I then fused the scan at 0.5mm and and meshed it with default settings.

name: Abu Al Gudour architectural elements
description:
# Tell Abu Al Gudour - Beheira

### 🗺️ Location
The archaeological site of Tell Abu Al Gudour is in northwestern Abu Al-Matamir. It holds a strategic position surrounded by major sites, located 7 km south of Kom Truji and Kom El-Saqia. It is bordered west by Kom Abu Nama and Abu El-Ada (~9 km), and east by Kom Radwan.

---

### 🏛️ Significance
Fieldwork uncovered architectural elements showing continuous stratification from the Ptolemaic to Byzantine eras. These remains shed light on regional development, trade routes, and settlement patterns of the western Nile Delta during Greco-Roman and Late Antique periods.

---

### 📊 Credits
* **3D Photogrammetry by:** Waleed Nosir.
* **Affiliation:** Archaeology Inspector, Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities .

description:
**Rumah Adat Osing** adalah rumah tradisional suku Osing yang tinggal di Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur. Arsitekturnya khas dengan atap tinggi berbentuk segitiga dan struktur kayu yang kuat. Terdapat beberapa tipe rumah, seperti crocosan, tikel balung, dan serangan, yang masing-masing memiliki filosofi dan fungsi berbeda. Rumah ini mencerminkan identitas budaya Osing sekaligus menyesuaikan dengan iklim tropis.

Osing Traditional House is the ancestral home of the Osing people in Banyuwangi, East Java. Its unique architecture features tall triangular roofs and strong wooden structures. Several types exist, such as crocosan, tikel balung, and serangan, each with distinct symbolism and functions. This house reflects Osing cultural identity while adapting to the tropical climate.

name: Laocoonte e figli
description:
Laocoonte e i figli – Un capolavoro della scultura classica

Obiettivi:
Comprendere il significato e il valore artistico dell’opera.
Osservare e analizzare una scultura attraverso un modello 3D.
Sviluppare competenze digitali e di lettura dell’immagine.

Attività:
Breve introduzione storico-mitologica.
Esplorazione interattiva del modello 3D su Sketchfab.
Discussione guidata e produzione di un breve elaborato individuale o di gruppo.

Competenze
Analisi visiva e interpretazione artistica.
Uso consapevole di strumenti digitali.
Collaborazione e comunicazione.

Laocoonte diventa non solo oggetto di studio artistico, ma un ponte tra passato e presente: la tridimensionalità e il gesto dei corpi trasmettono emozione, tecnica e senso di cura, trasformando l’osservazione in esperienza viva e interattiva.

A cura di Alessio Langella, per gli studenti dell’Istituto Tecnico Industriale di via degli Orti a Alghero (SS), con l’augurio di scoprire nell’arte antica un dialogo vivo tra passato, etica, tecnica e presente.

description:
📍 This photogrammetry model captures a severely deteriorated traditional wooden farmhouse in Lithuania, preserved in its authentic abandoned state.

The structure features a dramatically collapsed roof, damaged chimney masonry, warped timber construction, broken windows, and heavily weathered wooden siding. The building was documented exactly as found on-site, preserving real structural deformation and decades of natural decay.

🧩 The asset preserves highly realistic details including:
collapsed roofing geometry
exposed timber framework
damaged asbestos cement roof sheets
deteriorated brick chimney
broken windows
aged painted wood surfaces
authentic overgrowth and environmental wear

Unlike synthetic or manually sculpted models, this asset represents a real abandoned rural structure captured through photogrammetry for digital preservation purposes.

name: South American tapir
description:
The South American tapir is one of the four recognized species in the tapir family (of the order Perissodactyla) and It is the largest surviving native terrestrial mammal in the Amazon. It is dark brown, paler in the face, and has a low, erect crest running from the crown down the back of the neck. The round, dark ears have distinctive white edges. The body length measures from 1.8 to 2.5 m with a 5 to 10 cm short stubby tail and an average weight around 225 kg. It feeds on leaves, buds, shoots, and small branches it tears from trees, fruit, grasses, and aquatic plants.

Specimen: South American tapir, *Tapirus terrestris* (Linnaeus, 1758)

Inventory number: C 529

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa
 
Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

description:
12th Century medieval font

**Description**: Ancient font bowl, circular, unlined; one of group of Norman fonts in the county

**Methodology**: Photogrammetry Process: High-resolution capture with a Sony RX100 IV (DNG). Controlled lighting via Zhiyun M40 & M20 LED panels. RAW processing in Adobe Camera Raw. 3D reconstruction in Agisoft Metashape/Reality Scan.

**License**: CC BY 4.0. Model created by Shiro Morturn - Sudbury Digital Imaging for documentation and educational purposes.

Sudbury Gasworks Digital Imaging is a collaborative team of individuals working together for the benefit of the wider community to help record historic artifacts.
Our aims are to help people to take responsibility for the local buildings, artifacts, and landscapes they love. Giving them the power to transform people, places, and communities.
Please feel free to download and use this model. All we ask if that you like, leave a comment and give credit to the author Shiro Morturn.

description:
This model presents Welgelegen homestead heritage monument, situated in Rondebosch, Cape Town, South Africa. 

The project demonstrates the integration of Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) and close-range photogrammetry using RealityCapture software to produce an accurate and detailed representation of a heritage building.

Key Highlights:
Data captured using Z+F IMAGER 5010X and Nikon D7200.
Data fusion in RealityCapture.

Limitations: the model has incomplete roof due to absence of aerial data, and color inconsistencies due to the presence of trees.

name: KWK Ruda - Szyb Franciszek
description:
Jednym z charakterystycznych zabytków górniczych na terenie Rudy Śląskiej jest
kompleks szybu „Franciszek”, pamiętający czasy rudzkich kopalń: „Brandenburg”, „Hrabia
Franciszek”, „Walenty-Wawel”, „Wawel” i ”Pokój”.

Szyb wydrążono w 1857 r. jako jeden z trzech szybów wydobywczych kopalni
„Brandenburg”. Rejon szybu „Franciszek” budowano w okresie od drugiej połowy XIX do
pierwszej dekady XX w. W jego środkowej części usytuowano 22-metrową, dwupodziałową
wieżę wyciągową, budynek nadszybia oraz prawdziwą perłę architektury przemysłowej -
budynek straży pożarnej z ceglanymi, ozdobnymi elewacjami i urokliwą wieżą. Z uwagi na
wyróżniające cechy artystyczne: piękne detale architektury, czytelny układ założenia,
zachowaną oryginalną tkankę budowlaną, zespół szybu „Franciszek” został wpisany do
rejestru zabytków nieruchomych województwa śląskiego 29 sierpnia 1984 roku (nr rej.:
1324/84).

tekst: Tomasz Skowron

Szyb wydrążono w 1857 r. jako jeden z trzech szybów wydobywczych kopalni
„Brandenburg”. Rejon szybu „Franciszek” budowano w okresie od drugiej połowy XIX do
pierwszej dekady XX w. W jego środkowej części usytuowano 22-metrową, dwupodziałową
wieżę wyciągową, budynek nadszybia oraz prawdziwą perłę architektury przemysłowej -
budynek straży pożarnej z ceglanymi, ozdobnymi elewacjami i urokliwą wieżą. Z uwagi na
wyróżniające cechy artystyczne: piękne detale architektury, czytelny układ założenia,
zachowaną oryginalną tkankę budowlaną, zespół szybu „Franciszek” został wpisany do
rejestru zabytków nieruchomych województwa śląskiego 29 sierpnia 1984 roku (nr rej.:
1324/84).

name: Main Hall of Tianning Temple (天宁寺大殿)
description:
The Main Hall of Tianning Temple, a national key cultural relic protection unit, stands on the north bank of the Wujiang River in Jinhua, Zhejiang. Founded in the Dazhong Xiangfu period of the Northern Song Dynasty, it was rebuilt in 1318 (the 5th year of Yuan Dynasty's Yanyou reign) with some Song Dynasty components preserved. Square-shaped with three bays in both width and depth, it has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof. Its beam frame uses spliced small timbers, and the dougong (corbel brackets) adopt a rare six-tier structure with upward inner brackets. As one of the typical existing Yuan Dynasty wooden buildings in southern China, it integrates Song and Yuan architectural features, serving as a precious example for studying the evolution of ancient southern Chinese architecture.

金华天宁寺大殿为全国重点文物保护单位，坐落于浙江金华婺江北岸，始建于北宋大中祥符年间，元延祐五年（1318 年）重建并保留部分宋代构件。大殿面阔与进深均三间，呈正方形，单檐歇山顶，梁架采用小料拼合工艺，斗拱为六铺作单抄双下昂造，里跳上昂做法罕见。作为江南现存典型元代木构建筑之一，其融合宋、元建筑特征，是研究南方古建筑演变的珍贵实证。

name: The Indrica Catholic Church
description: The Indrica Catholic Church, located near the Daugava River , is the oldest extant wooden church in Latgale. Constructed between 1655–1658 and 1698 , it remains the oldest wooden structure in Latvia not rebuilt since the 17th century. This Baroque three-aisle hall-type log building features a polygonal apse and horizontal plank cladding. The facade is marked by a three-stage tower with a bell-shaped roof. Internally, a high degree of authenticity is preserved, including a rich wood-carved altar from the Stelmužė school and a crypt housing the Counts Plater family burials. The ensemble includes a fieldstone masonry fence and a unique three-stage bell tower. Despite a 1989 fire, the structure is in satisfactory condition following roof reconstruction. Current maintenance needs include addressing paint delamination and cleaning gutters from larch needle accumulation.

name: WIP-Lighting and render engine tests
description:
Things that I have noticed:

- Refracted objects can't be inside of other refracted objects. To get the water in the aquarium: I have the tank as a refracted object and a cube inside as the water that has its opacity reduced.
- For the bubbles, the one that seems to work the best is giving the bubbles Opacity + Bloom. I also really like how the purely Bloom bubbles glow; however, they are fully opaque (maybe a bit of both types?)
- For shadows, one needs to enable cats shadows, which seems to sadly mess with softness, but it is what it is. Furthermore, the perfect shadow bias value is 0.2132, this prevents shadow from acting strangely
- To get this lighting I had to bring the light quite close as the light's max strength is quite low this then made me have to increase the angle quite a lot. Increasing the angle starting introducing shadow grids, where one can clearly see the mesh polygons. (Looking from the other side of the window makes this extra apparent)

The rest is in the comments.

name: Miocen Mammal Tibia Fragment, Wyoming
description:
This 3D model is of specimen UW-43217 and is a proximal tibia from a large grazing mammal from the from the Browns Park Formation north of Saratoga, Wyoming. The Browns Park Formation of Wyoming is  Late Miocene (12–5 million years ago) in age, and represents rocks that were deposited when the region supported cool, open grasslands and a variety of grazing mammals. This specimen tells a rich taphonomic story: 🔍 Sun-cracking on the bone surfaces shows these animals’ remains lay exposed for weeks to months before burial. And the large crystals inside the tibia’s marrow cavity formed after burial, suggesting the bones sat below the water table long enough for slow crystal growth.

3D model captured using Abound App using photogrammetry.

name: Iglesia de Santianes del Rey Silo
description:
La iglesia de San Juan Apóstol y Evangelista, en Santianes de Pravia, es la más antigua que se conserva en la arquitectura prerrománica asturiana. Fue erigida por iniciativa del Rey Silo (774-783), después del traslado de la corte de Cangas de Onís a Pravia, y concebida como iglesia palatina con funciones de panteón real. La iglesia estaría enclavada en un lugar próximo al conjunto palaciego del rey, cuya ubicación no es posible determinar con exactitud, aunque parece que se construyó sobre un edificio anterior del que no quedan trazas. A la muerte de Silo, tanto la iglesia como el palacio se convirtieron en la residencia doméstica de la reina Adosinda.
La iglesia permaneció intacta hasta el siglo XVI, pero sufrió profundas transformaciones en los siglos XVII y XIX. En 1894, se descubrieron importantes restos arquitectónicos de la iglesia primitiva: una pilastra que servía de apoyo a las mesas del altar y dos canceles. Estas piezas fueron adquiridas por el historiador Fortunato de Selgas (1839-1921), en 1905.

name: Iguanodon
description: Iguanodon was a large, herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period, approximately 140 to 125 million years ago. It measured up to 10 meters (33 feet) in length and weighed around 3.5 metric tons. Iguanodon is known for its thumb spikes, which may have been used for defense against predators, and its ability to walk both on two legs and on all fours. Its beak-like mouth helped it strip leaves from trees and plants. Fossils of Iguanodon have been found primarily in Europe and North America, making it one of the first dinosaurs to be discovered and studied in detail, contributing greatly to early paleontology.

DA (Danish):
Denne model forestiller en gøgeunge i en rede, inspireret af natur- og fuglestudier.
Gøgen er kendt for at lægge sine æg i andre fugles reder, hvor ungen ofte overtager reden efter klækning.

Modellen er lavet af Mads Kreutzmann med fokus på form, proportioner og et stiliseret, men naturtro udtryk.
Projektet er en del af min udvikling inden for 3D-modellering.

EN (English):
This model represents a cuckoo chick in a nest, inspired by nature and bird behavior studies.
The cuckoo is known for laying its eggs in other birds' nests, where the chick often takes over after hatching.

The model is created by Mads Kreutzmann, focusing on shape, proportions, and a stylized yet natural look.
This project is part of my ongoing development in 3D modeling.

name: Traditional Sundanese House – Julang Ngapak
description:
This 3D model represents the Traditional Sundanese House “Julang Ngapak”, one of the most iconic forms of vernacular architecture from West Java, Indonesia. The term Julang Ngapak refers to the distinctive roof structure that resembles a bird spreading its wings (“ngapak”), symbolizing openness, balance, and harmony with nature.

The model is created with a focus on cultural authenticity and real-time performance optimization, making it suitable for use in game development, architectural visualization, virtual museums, educational platforms, and immersive VR/AR environments.

The structure reflects traditional Sundanese stilt house principles, where the building is elevated above the ground to adapt to tropical climates, improve air circulation, and provide protection from humidity and flooding. The roof form is the most recognizable element, featuring wide, upward-curving extensions that define the Julang Ngapak identity.

Composé de modules imprimés en 3D avec le système Kombino d’Arkitektoy, le stade révèle ici sa logique constructive : cadres, poutres, gradins, ouvertures, assemblages et pièces répétées qui forment peu à peu un grand volume architectural.

La maquette peut être démontée, transportée et recomposée en plusieurs parties. Cette décomposition aide à comprendre comment un bâtiment complexe se construit, morceau par morceau, comme sur un chantier réel.

Conçu pour des ateliers pédagogiques avec des enfants de 8 à 13 ans, le Stade Arkitektoy invite à découvrir l’architecture, l’impression 3D, les matériaux responsables et l’histoire des grands lieux de rassemblement, du théâtre grec aux stades contemporains.

Ce modèle montre le stade comme un objet architectural, ludique et éducatif : une construction que l’on observe, que l’on comprend, et que l’on peut imaginer autrement.

name: A Flag of Pakistan
description:
Title: Pakistan Flag – 3D Model (High Quality, Game Ready)

Description:
This Pakistan flag 3D model is perfect for educational projects, historical visualizations, national presentations, animations, and games. The model features the traditional green field with a white crescent and five-pointed star, symbolizing progress and light, along with the white stripe representing minorities.

The flag is optimized for both real-time use and high-quality renders, making it suitable for VR/AR, animations, documentaries, and cultural projects.

Historical Background:

The national flag of Pakistan was officially adopted on August 11, 1947, just a few days before the country’s independence. The flag was designed by Amiruddin Kidwai based on the All-India Muslim League banner. The dark green field represents Islam, the white vertical stripe represents religious minorities, while the crescent symbolizes progress and the five-pointed star stands for light and knowledge.

name: ホソスジヒバリガイ / Modiolus philippinarum
description:
幅広くやや薄質、よく膨らむ。殻表の後背縁は濃褐色、前背縁は殻頂から突出する。足糸開口部は狭い、殻毛はない。内面は濃紫色、奄美諸島以南、熱帯インドー西太平洋のサンゴ礁域の水深20mまでの藻場。

Broad and somewhat thin-walled, with good expansion. The posterior margin of the shell surface is dark brown, and the anterior margin protrudes from the apex. The foot pore is narrow, and there are no shell hairs. The inner surface is dark purple. Found in seagrass beds in coral reef areas of the tropical Indo-West Pacific, south of the Amami Islands, at depths of up to 20 m.

和名:ホソスジヒバリガイ

英名：Modiolus philippinarum

学名：Modiolus philippinarum (Hanley,1843)  イガイ科　Mytilidae

殻長：8.5cm

参考文献：「日本近海産貝類図鑑」【第二版】奥谷喬司 編著 東海大学出版部（2017年1月）

description:
A rhinoceros cranium from the Science Museum of Minnesota biology collection. This cranium has the numbers: 106 0-12 written on it.

I was able to retain more of the delicate nasal concha (thin bony strips) in the nasal cavity. The rhino nose is bumpy--characteristic of this animal, and this version is better aligned. Those bumps were difficult to model accurately!

name: Superando barreras: modelo de fotogrametría
description:
La escultura Superando barreras, obra en bronce de los hermanos Saiz Manrique e instalada en la avenida de Palencia (Burgos), homenajea a las personas con discapacidad y convirtió a la ciudad en pionera en dedicarles un monumento. 

Para preservar la pieza y facilitar su uso en entornos digitales, se realizó una captura 3D con RealityScan, obteniendo un modelo de unos 40 millones de polígonos. Tras un proceso de optimización y retopología, la malla se redujo a 20.000 polígonos, conservando la forma esencial y permitiendo su uso fluido en aplicaciones interactivas, motores gráficos o proyectos de accesibilidad digital.

Cualquier problema pese a ser con fines educativos contacten con la secretaría de la Universidad de Burgos.

name: Animated Ichthyotitan Severnensis
description:
Ichthyotitan severnensis was a prehstoric marine reptile that lived during the Triassic period around 202–201 million years ago, and it is one of the largest animals to have ever lived on Earth, with size estimates suggesting it was comparable to, or possibly even rivaling, the modern blue whale in length. Based on jaw fossils discovered, this ichthyosaur likely reached over 20–25 meters long,. Unlike predators that relied on crushing bites, its exact bite force is unknown, but scientists believe it was not exceptionally high, as Ichthyotitan probably used suction feeding or rapid jaw snapping to consume large prey such as fish and squid. It lived long before dinosaurs dominated the land, proving that extreme gigantism evolved in the oceans much earlier, and its discovery reshaped our understanding of how fast marine reptiles could grow to enormous sizes.

name: African Bush Elephant
description: The African bush elephant (Loxodonta africana), also known as the African savanna elephant, is a species of elephant native to sub-Saharan Africa. It is one of three extant elephant species and, along with the African forest elephant, one of two extant species of African elephant. It is the largest living terrestrial animal, with fully grown bulls reaching an average shoulder height of 3.04–3.36 metres (10.0–11.0 ft) and a body mass of 5.2–6.9 tonnes (11,000–15,000 lb); the largest recorded specimen had a shoulder height of 3.96 metres (13.0 ft) and an estimated body mass of 10.4 tonnes (23,000 lb). The African bush elephant is characterised by its long prehensile trunk with two finger-like processes; a convex back; large ears which help reduce body heat; and sturdy tusks that are noticeably curved. The skin is grey with scanty hairs, and bending cracks which support thermoregulation by retaining water.

name: Barber Chair
description:
recently completed a barber chair project and focused on making it look realistic and game-ready.
I started by collecting references from Pinterest and arranged them in PureRef. This helped me a lot during modeling and texturing. First, I made a high-poly model to capture all the small details, then I converted it into a clean low-poly version for game use.
For some parts, I used a remesh workflow to fix the topology and get better shapes before finalizing the low-poly.
After that, I baked the details carefully so everything transferred well from high-poly to low-poly. The bake came out clean, which really helped in getting a realistic look.
For texturing, I again used PureRef to stay close to real-life references and tried to keep the materials natural and believable.
This project helped me improve my overall workflow from high-poly to low-poly, baking, and texturing, while keeping everything optimized for real-time use.
High Poly Triangles: 1,196,272
Low Poly Triangles: 4,972

name: CASA DO LAGO
description:
Projetada para momentos de descanso e conexão, a Casa do Lago nasce da combinação entre arquitetura contemporânea, materiais naturais e uma implantação pensada para valorizar a paisagem.

Localizada na região da Colônia Witmarsum, no Paraná, e inspirada pelo cenário dos pinus e pela proximidade de um lago natural, a residência foi concebida como um espaço de lazer para fins de semana, oferecendo conforto, privacidade e convivência.

Com estrutura em madeira, acabamentos rústicos de alto padrão e ambientes integrados, o projeto privilegia a iluminação natural, a relação entre interior e exterior e a experiência de viver em contato com a natureza.

A área social se abre para o terraço e a piscina, criando um espaço acolhedor para receber amigos e familiares, enquanto a suíte principal e o quarto de hóspedes garantem conforto e tranquilidade.

En este templete se hallaba el famosos Monolito Bennett y varias piezas originales que hasta el año 2005 fueron llevadas nuevamente a Tiwanaku al Complejo Arqueológico Monumental de Tiahuanaco.
Actualmente en su centro se encuentra una réplica del monolito Benett, las estelas, las  cabezas clavas como tambien las piezas que lo componen todas trabajadas en piedra y traidas de la region de Guaqui. (Captura 2015) (Modelo Borrador)

name: diplodocus V2
description:
Introducing Diplodocus, one of the longest land animals to ever walk the Earth. With its iconic elongated neck and tail, Diplodocus was a graceful, plant-eating sauropod that dominated the lush floodplains of Late Jurassic North America. Its tail, thought to act like a whip or counterbalance, and its low-slung body made it one of the most easily recognized dinosaurs in the fossil record.

This detailed 3D model captures Diplodocus in lifelike accuracy—from its gentle herbivore expression to its intricately textured skin and sweeping tail. Ideal for paleo displays, educational content, games, or 3D printing, this model celebrates the elegance of sauropod evolution.

name: The Flamecrawler
description:
This model is a fan-made creation inspired by Horizon Zero Dawn, from Guerrilla Games. I do not own the characters, settings, or original concepts — all rights belong to their respective owners. This piece is created purely for non-commercial, artistic expression and is not intended to infringe on any copyrights or trademarks.

The Flamecrawler is a large Acquisition Class machine that resembles a centipede. It was designed by GAIA with the intent to process and purify soil, removing industrial pollutants and chemical contamination. It has proved to be a dangerous machine to hunt, not only due to its ability to move subterraneously, but thanks to its ability to eject and detonate canisters filled with flammable chemicals. The drills on its tail can be launched like a harpoon, and its radio antennae alert nearby machines of human activity.

Modelled, textured and animated as a student for a uni project.

name: Anoplophora birmanica
description:
The blue longhorned beetle is a striking beetle species from the longhorned beetle family (Cerambycidae). It is characterized by its metallic blue to mint-coloured body colouring, which gives it a particularly exotic appearance. Like many species of the genus Anoplophora, it has long, banded antennae, which can be significantly longer than the body in males. A. birmanica originates from Southeast Asia and mainly inhabits forested regions. The beetles reach a body length of around 40 to 60 millimeters, although individual specimens can also be larger.

Der blaue Bockkäfer ist eine auffällige Käferart aus der Familie der Cerambycidae. Er zeichnet sich durch seine metallisch blaue bis mintfarbene Körperfärbung aus, die ihm ein besonders exotisches Aussehen verleiht. Er besitzt lange, gebänderte Fühler, die bei den Männchen deutlich länger als der Körper sein können. Er stammt aus Südostasien und bewohnt vor allem bewaldete Regionen und erreicht eine Länge von 4 bis 6 cm.

name: Piranesi Table
description: I have always admired the work of Giovanni Battista Piranesi (1720-1778). He was a towering figure of the 18th century, best known for his dramatic and imaginative etchings of Rome. Though trained as an architect, he found his true calling not in building, but in depicting architecture through his prints. From 1740, he had an opportunity to work in Rome as a draughtsman for Marco Foscarini, the Venetian ambassador (and future Doge of Venice) to the new Pope Benedict XIV. He resided in the Palazzo Venezia and studied under Giuseppe Vasi, who introduced him to the art of etching and engraving of the city and its monuments. Giuseppe Vasi found Piranesi's talent was much greater than that of a mere engraver. According to Legrand, Vasi told Piranesi that "you are too much of a painter, my friend, to be an engraver."

name: Chandra Shekhar Azad Memorial, Prayagraj,UP
description:
Chandra Shekhar Azad Park (Alfred Park) in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, is a historic 133-acre urban park where Indian revolutionary Chandra Shekhar Azad sacrificed his life on February 27, 1931, after a fierce gun battle with British police.
Key Highlights:
Chandra Shekhar Azad Memorial: Features a bronze statue marking the exact location where Azad died beneath a jamun tree to uphold his pledge never to be captured alive.
Allahabad Museum: Located within the park complex, displaying historical artifacts including Azad’s Colt pistol.
Heritage Landmarks: Houses the Gothic-style Allahabad Public Library and the Victoria Memorial Canopy.

name: La Riba de Santiuste Bridge (Sigüenza, Spain)
description:
**Description**: Located in the small village of La Riba de Santiuste (Sigüenza, Spain), this bridge was built between 1905 and 1907 to replace a previous, much older bridge that had been rendered almost unusable by the repeated flooding of the Salado River. For centuries, La Riba de Santiuste held a strategic position not only for its castle but also for its bridge over the Salado River. In fact, as early as 1693, the bridge, which at that time had five arches, needed repairs. However, in 1905, master stonemason Serafín Caramés y Caramés was commissioned to build a new bridge. A solid work that has survived to this day.

**Methodology**: This model was created in RealityScan from 20 laser scans and 929 images. Additional processing in Geomagic Wrap.

name: Goojingiin Öndör
description:
Endangered Wooden Architecture Program (EWAP3147SG): Goojingiin Öndör 

Goojingiin Öndör is a historic wooden building constructed in 1915 for the Russian advisor S.A. Kozin during Mongolia’s early 20th-century political transition. After Kozin’s departure, it changed function many times. During the 1920s Chinese military presence in Ikh Khüree (now Ulaanbaatar), it housed the 8th Bogd Jebtsundamba Khutuktu under house arrest. The two-storey structure, built in the East Siberian style, features log walls, carved wooden details, and a gabled metal roof. Despite its designation as a cultural heritage site in 1969, the building has been neglected since the collapse of socialism in the 1990s, with unclear ownership and limited legal protection. Now abandoned and in critical condition, Goojingiin Öndör stands as a fragile yet important witness to Mongolia’s layered architectural and political history.

Funded by: EWAP and ARCADIA
Hosted by: Khuree architects NGO
Scanned by: Batjin Nyamtsogt & Dorjnamjim Ganzorig

name: Bai Harir Vav, Wall Detail, Ahmedabad, India
description:
LiDAR-based 3D documentation of a carved wall detail at Bai Harir Vav, a historic stepwell in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

Built in the late 15th century under the Gujarat Sultanate, Bai Harir Vav is a notable example of Indo-Islamic stepwell architecture, combining water infrastructure with richly ornamented stone construction. Stepwells (vavs) served as groundwater access systems and as cool, semi-subterranean social and ceremonial spaces. The wall detail shown here carries the carved stone language of the site: geometric rhythm and ornamental motifs shaped by both function and aesthetics.

Capture: LiDAR scanning with Scaniverse (iPad Pro), processed for web delivery (390.7k triangles, 195.5k vertices).

Part of an ongoing research project on stepwell (vav) architecture in India, documenting architectural ornament across Gujarat and Rajasthan.

📍 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

name: ACR103_A2_YPVinuya_Apartment Tower
description:
Reference:

Correa, F. (n.d.). Bar chino [Digital illustration]. ArtStation. https://www.artstation.com/artwork/Nx2Kr5

Acknoledgement:

The environment was based on Fernando Correa's concept illustration Bar chino, which was selected because its modular architectural forms, stylised line work and environmental storytelling aligned closely with the artistic direction I wanted to explore throughout this project. Rather than reproducing the artwork exactly, I used it as a visual guide while constructing unseen elevations and additional environmental details through my own design decisions.

Design Note: 
The "MOXES" graffiti featured within the environment is a small homage to Cyberpunk 2077 and was included as an original environmental easter egg rather than as part of the source concept artwork.

name: Animated Realistic Hairless Chimpanzee
description:
# Here's a custom made low poly model of a Chimpanzee without its hair!

This model is provided with a rig that gives you full control over its body and facial expressions. It also gives you detailed control over the facial expression with its **39** blend shapes. 
The model comes with a total of 5 different Chimpanzee skin variants, one of which is showcased here. It also comes with 3 different eye colors.
The model's textures are also suited for Unity URP and Unreal Engine 5.

Hope you like it!


# **This model with its .ZIP file includes:**

* **2K** PBR Metallic Roughness Textures
* **2K** Unreal Engine 5 Textures
* **2K** Unity Universal Render Pipeline Textures
* A Low Poly **.FBX** Model
* A **.BLEND** file of the rigged Chimpanzee.
* A **.BLEND** file of the Chimpanzee and its animations showcased in the Sketchfab 3D Viewer.

**Programs Used:**

* Sculpted and retopo'd in **ZBrush**
* Retopology and UV unwrapped in **Maya**
* Textured in **Substance 3D Painter**
* Edited and Rigged in **Blender**

name: Soho Park Building
description:
This 3D model presents a scan of a small historic building located in a park in the heart of Soho, London. Captured using Polycam from a smartphone video, the model reflects both the architectural charm and the atmospheric surroundings of this urban green space.

The structure appears to serve a utility or service function within the park, blending classical elements with modern context. The scan captures the textures of brickwork, roof details, and surrounding greenery, offering a lifelike representation of the site.

This model was generated from a video walkthrough, showcasing the capabilities of mobile 3D scanning and photogrammetry for rapid urban documentation.

Ideal for architectural reference, urban studies, or digital preservation.

name: Chateau du Haut-Koenigsbourg
description:
Voici une reproduction que j'ai faite du château du Haut-Koenigsbourg, situé en Alsace.
Le modèle a été initialement réalisé en 2018 avec Lightwave 3D, mais je l'ai récemment repris dans 3D-Coat et Blender pour en refaire tous les dépliages UV et peindre les textures afin que le modèle pusse être utilisé dans des moteurs d'affichage 3D en temps réel.
La modélisation, le dépliage UV et les textures ont demandé entre 180 et 200 heures de travail.
Afin de permettre un affichage plus rapide, les textures sont ici en 4K. Le modèle d'origine a des textures 8K.

description:
This diorama captures the precise moment a community staple, Café L’Original, is lost to corporate rebranding. Through environmental storytelling, the scene explores the clash between 40 years of craftsmanship and modern "efficiency.

- The Transition: A delivery truck full of generic metal stools replaces the hand-carved furniture, while the old owners' plant sits neglected on the curb.

Technical Specs:
- Modeled in Blender 5.1.

name: Entelodont: Swine of the Eocene
description:
Entelodont: The Terrifying Swine of the Eocene

In the Eocene epoch, the formidable Entelodont, often referred to as the "Terminator Pig" or "Hell Pig," dominates the prehistoric landscapes with its nightmarish visage. This apex predator, though distantly related to modern pigs, boasts a set of menacing features. With a large head, marked by powerful jaws and sharp teeth, this predator strikes an imposing figure. Standing at an intimidating height and weighing several hundred kilograms, the Entelodont is one of the largest terrestrial predators of its time. Its robust build and formidable weaponry make it a force to be reckoned with. As a hypercarnivorous predator, the Entelodont likely played a crucial role in maintaining the balance of ecosystems during the Eocene. name: Entelodont: Swine of the Eocene
description:
Entelodont: The Terrifying Swine of the Eocene

In the Eocene epoch, the formidable Entelodont, often referred to as the "Terminator Pig" or "Hell Pig," dominates the prehistoric landscapes with its nightmarish visage. This apex predator, though distantly related to modern pigs, boasts a set of menacing features. With a large head, marked by powerful jaws and sharp teeth, this predator strikes an imposing figure. Standing at an intimidating height and weighing several hundred kilograms, the Entelodont is one of the largest terrestrial predators of its time. Its robust build and formidable weaponry make it a force to be reckoned with. As a hypercarnivorous predator, the Entelodont likely played a crucial role in maintaining the balance of ecosystems during the Eocene. While the social dynamics of Entelodonts remain speculative, some evidence suggests a degree of social structure, possibly involving familial groups or loose aggregations for hunting and protection.

name: Tarçın
description:
Tarçın was a beloved stray dog who became a symbol of the Moda neighborhood (in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul). "Tarçın" means "Cinnamon", referencing the color of this dog's fur. 

Although sometimes welcomed into local homes, Tarçın preferred to live freely on the streets, and was a daily presence for residents who fed and cared for her.

Tarçın lived in Moda for around 17–18 years. She tragically lost her life around 2016 after being hit by a car driving the wrong way. The driver left without checking on her, and the community mourned the loss deeply.

In honor of Tarçın, sculptor İskender Giray created a statue of her in her favorite spot near the Moda cape, set on a concrete cushion, where she would often wait for her human friends. 

This statue has become a much-loved local landmark, serving as both a tribute to Tarçın and a symbol of the affection many Istanbul neighborhoods have for their street animals

Zion Baptist Chapel, New Road, Newtown. The present chapel dates to 1881, designed by the architect George Morgan, who was foremost for the Baptist denomination at the time. A staircase, four corinithian columns, a pediment and a Dutch gable dominate the front elevation.  The building is Grade II Listed.

name: Free Gameready Crowd Control Barricade model
description:
**Free for any use. Attribution required: Made by LQC.**

Model has been created with Blender©. Textures were made and baked using Adobe Substance Painter.

A heavy crowd-control barricade made from a solid concrete block reinforced with a mounted steel containment frame. The concrete is rough, grey, and stained with grime, marked by a worn yellow and white restriction stripe that’s chipped and faded from long-term use.

Two steel beams are embedded into the block, supporting a bolted metal frame with wire mesh. The metal is dark, weathered, and scuffed, showing oxidation and impact wear. The overall condition suggests repeated deployment in tense urban situations and protests, not all of them peaceful.

Game-ready asset optimized with three Levels of Detail (LODs).

name: Cubo .Maria Lucia Irias
description: Al realizar este ejercicio del cubo, pudimos experimentar cómo, a partir de una forma geométrica simple, es posible generar diferentes propuestas espaciales sin perder su esencia original. A través de extracciones, adiciones y modificaciones en sus caras, fuimos transformando el volumen y explorando cómo cada intervención puede cambiar su percepción y generar nuevas formas. Este proceso nos permitió entender cómo una idea inicial puede ir cobrando vida mediante la transformación del espacio y cómo, a través de operaciones sencillas, podemos crear una composición arquitectónica con mayor dinamismo y personalidad.

name: Лестница на монокосоуре с тросовыми ограждениями
description:
Тип проекта:
Современная лестница на усиленном монокосоуре с массивными деревянными ступенями толщиной 80 мм и тросовыми ограждениями.

Описание:
3D модель лестницы с акцентом на минималистичный внешний вид и визуальную лёгкость конструкции. Толстый центральный монокосоур обеспечивает жёсткость каркаса, а ступени увеличенной толщины создают эффект массивности и премиального исполнения.

Конструктивные особенности:
— Центральный монокосоур увеличенного сечения
— Деревянные ступени толщиной 80 мм
— Тросовое ограждение с металлическими стойками
— Открытая лестница без подступенков

Назначение:
Подобные решения часто используются в современных интерьерах частных домов, где важны чистые линии и лёгкий визуальный образ.

Проектирование:
Модель создана на основе реальных конструктивных решений и используется для визуализации лестниц перед изготовлением.

description:
DogDay is an anthropomorphic orange-furred dog with black eyes, floppy ears, a black nose, and a yellow outer mouth and belly. name: Diamantinasaurus 3D Reconstruction & Animation
description:
An Australian sauropod walks again?! **Diamantinasaurus matildae** (*Named after 'Waltzing Matilda', which was written in the same town it was found*) was a large somphospondylan sauropod from the Late Cretaceous Winton Formation of Queensland, Australia (**101-94 million years ago**).

This 3D skeletal reconstruction was created by [Astrid O'Connor](http://www.instagram.com/palaeoastrid/) in Blender (v3.4) in collaboration with **Dr Stephen Poropat** and **Sam Beeston**. This specimen is based and scaled largely on the newly described specimen 'Judy' (AODF 0888; AODL 0246) (see Poropat *et al.* 2025 **Current Biology**) with missing bones scaled from other referred specimens. The cranium is largely based on specimens AODF 0906 & AODF 0836.

We greatly thank **Steve** and **Sam** for their skeletal insights and for the many wonderful bone surface scans made avilable through Morphosource.

name: World
description:
World Model Description
A world model is a computational representation of the world, designed to simulate, predict, and understand complex systems and phenomena. It integrates various data sources, including sensory inputs, expert knowledge, and empirical evidence, to create a comprehensive and dynamic representation of reality.

Key Features
1. Interconnectedness: A world model acknowledges the intricate relationships between various components, such as social, economic, environmental, and technological systems.
2. Dynamic behavior: The model captures the dynamic nature of the world, incorporating feedback loops, nonlinear interactions, and emergent properties.
3. Uncertainty and ambiguity: A world model accounts for uncertainty, ambiguity, and incomplete knowledge, using probabilistic representations and sensitivity analysis.
4. Scalability and adaptability: The model is designed to adapt to changing conditions, incorporating new data and knowledge, and scaling to accommodate diverse applications.

name: Dolmen de Pedra Cubierta - Galicia | SPAIN
description:
El dolmen de Piedra Cubierta se encuentra en la parroquia de Treos, en el municipio de Vimianzo.

Es de grandes proporciones con un corredor de entrada de más de seis metros (6,6 m) de largo y con una altura de casi dos metros (1,80 m). Fáltalle la lousa de cobertura de la Cámara principal. En él se encontró la pintura de un ídolo en colores rojo y negra sobre blanco.

Las pinturas se han realizado sobre una capa de color blanco, probablemente caolín, utilizando el negro y el rojo. El rojo se preparó con óxidos de hierro y el negro con carbón vegetal aglutinados con albumina de huevo. Son formas geométricas y líneas onduladas en vertical y horizontal, círculos concéntricos y triángulos.

Están dispuestas en tres fajas horizontales, al igual que en el dolmen de Dombate. En la inferior se ven dos fajas paralelas largas de color rojo con forma de ondas de perfiles rectos que parecen zigzags en unos lados y arcos superpuestos en otros.

FAB : https://www.fab.com/es-es/listings/9c1dfb73-05f6-42d8-afd4-100704386fb7

description:
An Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is a computer model inspired by the way the human brain works.
It’s made up of layers of simple units called neurons, which take in numbers, process them, and pass the results to the next layer.
By adjusting the connections (called weights) between neurons, an ANN learns patterns from data—like recognizing images, understanding speech, or predicting trends.

It’s basically a math-based pattern learner that gets better the more examples you give it.

name: Philip Quigly (1779-1836) Headstone
description: One of 162 headstones in Castletownarra graveyard (TN019-002002-), County Tipperary, recorded in 1982 by the Ormond Historical Society. 19th-century slate headstone marking the grave of Philip Quigly (born c. 1779) who died in April of 1836 aged 57 years old. The memorial was erected by his son John. Above the inscription there is an I H S Christogram with a lozenge-filled Latin Cross rising from the top of the H contained within a foliate wreath. Above there is the acronym INRI (Iesus Nazarenus Rex Iudaeorum/Jesus the Nazarene, King of the Jews). The trumpeting angel announcing Judgement Day when the dead arise from their grave on the Day of Resurrection. Either side of the cross there is a winged-face/soul-effigy, beneath which there is a Noah’s Dove, with encircled crowing rooster below. A Christogram is a combination of letters that forms an abbreviation for the name of Jesus Christ, spelt ΙΗΣΟΥΣ in Greek capitals. Possibly the work of the stonecutter, Gunning of Killaloe, Co. Clare.

name: Fiat Palio 2002
description:
This car holds very special value to me as it was my first car I owned. The green color here really does'nt do justice to the real life color. Lots of memories with this car, growing up with a car which was essentially made in my birth year. The sleek design paired with comfort and powerfule FIRE engine really sells the appeal of this car. **If I could, I would still buy it over any of the cars available today. **

In 2002, the Fiat Palio redefined the Indian hatchback segment. Designed by the legendary Giorgetto Giugiaro, the Palio 1.2L brought Italian flair and heavy-duty engineering to a market dominated by lightweight city cars. At its heart lies the 1.2L FIRE (Fully Integrated Robotised Engine), a unit praised for its refinement and mid-range punch.

It remains a benchmark for ride comfort and high-speed stability in the hatchback class. With its jewel-shaped clear-lens headlamps and vertical tail lights, the Palio 1.2 is a timeless reminder of when cars were built to last, not just to commute.

name: Tri-colored Camel with Musicians (三彩载乐骆驼俑)
description:
The Tri-colored Camel with Musicians is a masterpiece of Tang Dynasty tri-color pottery and a national treasure. It was unearthed from a Tang tomb in Zhongbao Village, southern Xi'an in 1959. The robust camel raises its head. On its back sits a square platform with eight vivid figures. Seven musicians play instruments around it, while a Hu female dancer performs in the middle. It vividly presents the prosperity of the Silk Road and cultural integration among different ethnic groups in the flourishing Tang Dynasty..

三彩载乐骆驼俑是唐代三彩器中的巅峰之作，国宝级文物，1959 年出土于西安南郊中堡村唐墓。骆驼体态雄健、昂首扬首，背上驮着方形平台，八名乐舞人物神态鲜活。七名乐手分坐四周演奏乐器，一名胡人女子立于中央翩翩起舞，生动还原了盛唐丝绸之路商旅往来、胡乐胡舞盛行、各民族文化交融的繁华景象。

description:
Entre la fin du 1ºr siècle avant notre ère et la première moitié du 1°r siècle de notre ère
Argent martelé et coulé (mains)
Lieu de culte, Fanum 4
Découverte en 2007, dans une petite fosse située sous le sol de circulation de la cella d'un petit temple de la ville de Briga (Fanum 5), cette exceptionnelle statuette de Mercure en tôle d'argent témoigne de la place particulière qu'occupait le dieu parmi les divinités honorées de cette agglomération. L'absence d'ailes du pétase, la fragmentation du caducée, la fracturation de l'avant-bras droit tendant la bourse et la mutilation du sexe, confirment la désacralisation de l'objet avant son enfouissement.

name: M.C.Escher - Other World II
description:
My journey into Escher’s Other World began several years ago. It started as an exploration of his original works—both the 1946 Other World and its successor, the 1947 Other World II. My ambition was to adapt these iconic serigraphs into 3D space, translating Escher’s surreal vision into a form that could be navigated and experienced. A dimension I truly believe Escher would have delighted in.

If you want to learn more about this project you can check out the essay on my website. :>
https://andreacigognetti.com/other-world/

It successfully defended the World Constructors' Championship title and won the World Drivers' Championship with Norris as he became the first McLaren champion since Lewis Hamilton in 2008.
